## The Rule

**Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action** — including clarifying questions, exploring the codebase, or checking files. If it turns out wrong for the situation, you don't have to use it.

## Skill Priority

When multiple skills apply, process skills come first — they set the approach, then implementation skills (frontend-design, etc.) carry it out. Brainstorming and systematic-debugging are Superpowers' most common process skills, but the rule holds for any of them.

- "Let's build X" → superpowers:brainstorming first, then implementation skills.
- "Fix this bug" → superpowers:systematic-debugging first, then domain skills.

These thoughts mean STOP—you're rationalizing:

| Thought | Reality |
|---------|---------|
| "This is just a simple question" | Questions are tasks. Check for skills. |
| "I need more context first" | Skill check comes BEFORE clarifying questions. |
| "Let me explore the codebase first" | Skills tell you HOW to explore. Check first. |
| "I can check git/files quickly" | Files lack conversation context. Check for skills. |
| "Let me gather information first" | Skills tell you HOW to gather information. |
| "This doesn't need a formal skill" | If a skill exists, use it. |
| "I remember this skill" | Skills evolve. Read current version. |
| "This doesn't count as a task" | Action = task. Check for skills. |
| "The skill is overkill" | Simple things become complex. Use it. |
| "I'll just do this one thing first" | Check BEFORE doing anything. |
| "This feels productive" | Undisciplined action wastes time. Skills prevent this. |
| "I know what that means" | Knowing the concept ≠ using the skill. Invoke it. |

## User Instructions

</EXTREMELY_IMPORTANT>"
  }
}

2	name: binance-mcp-real-server-facts
3	description: Verified wire facts about the real Binance Agent OS MCP server (pagination, hidden catalog, error envelope, account defaults) and the Claude Code needs-auth-per-name quirk
4	metadata:
5	  type: project
6	---
7	
8	Real endpoint https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic; OAuth (PKCE) only for listed clients (Claude Code, Codex); custom
9	client_ids get error 3346001. Binance hosts are blocked without a VPN on the user's ISP (TLS reset in 0.1 s).
10	Verified 2026-09-06 after OAuth: tools/list is PAGINATED (81 exposed tools over 2 pages); tool_search(category) exposes a
11	316-tool hidden catalog callable via tool_execute(toolName, arguments); serverInfo is "Tesla-MCP-Server" 1.0.0 with long
12	instructions; one resource (portfolio workflow). Names: spot.newOrder, futures_usds.changeInitialLeverage,
13	futures_usds.positionInformationV2, futures_usds.futuresAccountBalanceV3, futures_usds.accountInformationV3,
14	convert.sendQuoteRequest, wallet.userUniversalTransfer; futures_usds.markPrice is hidden (tool_execute only).
15	Errors are JSON-RPC errors code -32603 with message = raw Binance JSON string (e.g. {"code":-1013,"msg":"Filter failure: LOT_SIZE"});
16	unknown tool_execute target: "Tool not found: '<name>'. Call tool_search ...". Success = content text JSON + structuredContent.
17	A fresh Agentic sub-account is CROSS margin at 20x on every symbol; positionInformationV2 returns a zero row; balances list many assets.
18	Confirmation is instruction-based (no elicitation/token). Numbers are strings.
19	fstream aggTrade/markPrice WS streams returned nothing; trade + bookTicker work; twin polls /fapi/v1/premiumIndex.
20	Claude Code caches an OAuth "needs-auth" state PER SERVER NAME, so a twin registered as binance-mcp-server is refused while
21	the real one is registered; the runner falls back to the MCP name binance-twin.
22	Runner decisions: runner.preamble pre-authorises writes in headless sessions while still requiring the restatement line;
23	runner.model defaults to sonnet (~$0.5/session); --no-api-key strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to use the claude.ai login.
24	schemas/tools.json + catalog.json + resources.json are dumped and `rehearsal schema validate --live-url` = ZERO DRIFT.
25	
26	**Why:** these facts cost hours of probing and are not derivable from the repo.
27	**How to apply:** re-run `rehearsal schema dump` if Binance changes the surface; keep tool_map.yaml in sync with the real names.
28	See [[binance-agent-os-hackathon]].

---
name: binance-mcp-real-server-facts
description: Verified wire facts about the real Binance Agent OS MCP server (pagination, hidden catalog, error envelope, account defaults) and the Claude Code needs-auth-per-name quirk
metadata:
  type: project
---

Real endpoint https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic; OAuth (PKCE) only for listed clients (Claude Code, Codex); custom
client_ids get error 3346001. Binance hosts are blocked without a VPN on the user's ISP (TLS reset in 0.1 s).
Verified 2026-09-06 after OAuth: tools/list is PAGINATED (81 exposed tools over 2 pages); tool_search(category) exposes a
316-tool hidden catalog callable via tool_execute(toolName, arguments); serverInfo is "Tesla-MCP-Server" 1.0.0 with long
instructions; one resource (portfolio workflow). Names: spot.newOrder, futures_usds.changeInitialLeverage,
futures_usds.positionInformationV2, futures_usds.futuresAccountBalanceV3, futures_usds.accountInformationV3,
convert.sendQuoteRequest, wallet.userUniversalTransfer; futures_usds.markPrice is hidden (tool_execute only).
Errors are JSON-RPC errors code -32603 with message = raw Binance JSON string (e.g. {"code":-1013,"msg":"Filter failure: LOT_SIZE"});
unknown tool_execute target: "Tool not found: '<name>'. Call tool_search ...". Success = content text JSON + structuredContent.
A fresh Agentic sub-account is CROSS margin at 20x on every symbol; positionInformationV2 returns a zero row; balances list many assets.
Confirmation is instruction-based (no elicitation/token). Numbers are strings.
fstream aggTrade/markPrice WS streams returned nothing; trade + bookTicker work; twin polls /fapi/v1/premiumIndex.
Claude Code caches an OAuth "needs-auth" state PER SERVER NAME, so a twin registered as binance-mcp-server is refused while
the real one is registered; the runner falls back to the MCP name binance-twin.
Runner decisions: runner.preamble pre-authorises writes in headless sessions while still requiring the restatement line;
runner.model defaults to sonnet (~$0.5/session); --no-api-key strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to use the claude.ai login.
schemas/tools.json + catalog.json + resources.json are dumped and `rehearsal schema validate --live-url` = ZERO DRIFT.

**Why:** these facts cost hours of probing and are not derivable from the repo.
**How to apply:** re-run `rehearsal schema dump` if Binance changes the surface; keep tool_map.yaml in sync with the real names.
See [[binance-agent-os-hackathon]].

content.text: Starting the rehearsal session: fetching account balance and 15m klines for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT to compute momentum.
Momentum: BTCUSDT ≈ 1.000139, ETHUSDT ≈ 1.001975 (last close 2499.65 vs 20-bar avg 2494.72). ETHUSDT wins. Free USDT = 1000.00. Now fetching exchange filters for ETHUSDT.

Entry: ETHUSDT filters — stepSize 0.0001 (4 decimals), tickSize 0.01 (2 decimals), minNotional 5. Sizing: usdt_to_spend = min(180, 700) = 180; qty = floor((180/2499.65)/0.0001)*0.0001 = 0.0720 ETH (≈179.97 USDT, within 200 cap, gross 179.97 ≤ 600). Checks pass (qty≥minQty, notional≥minNotional, ≤200, gross≤600).

Restating write: ETHUSDT, BUY, MARKET, quantity 0.0720.
Buy filled: 0.0720 ETH @ avg 2503.04 (180.21888 USDT), commission 0.000072 ETH. Now fetching updated account balance for the real ETH free amount before placing the take-profit.

Take-profit sizing: free ETH = 0.071928 → sell_qty = floor(0.071928/0.0001)*0.0001 = 0.0719 ETH; price = floor((2499.65×1.002)/0.01)*0.01 = 2504.64. Checks: sell notional 180.08 ≤ 200; combined 360.30 ≤ 600.

Restating write: ETHUSDT, SELL, LIMIT, GTC, quantity 0.0719, price 2504.64.
Take-profit resting as NEW (orderId 10000002). Proceeding to close the session flat: checking open orders first.

The take-profit (orderId 10000002) is still resting, unfilled. Cancelling it to close the session flat.

Restating write: ETHUSDT, CANCEL, orderId 10000002 (the SELL LIMIT take-profit, qty 0.0719 @ 2504.64).
Cancelled. Now checking free ETH balance to flatten the position.

Free ETH = 0.071928, notional ≈179.79 USDT (above minNotional) — not dust, flattening now.

Restating write: ETHUSDT, SELL, MARKET, quantity 0.0719.
Flatten fill: sold 0.0719 ETH @ avg 2502.95, proceeds 179.9621 USDT (commission 0.17996 USDT). Confirming no resting orders remain.

## Session Summary

- **Chosen symbol:** ETHUSDT (momentum 1.00197 vs BTCUSDT 1.00014 — both above 1.0)
- **Entry:** BUY MARKET 0.0720 ETH filled @ avg 2503.04 → cost 180.21888 USDT
- **Take-profit:** SELL LIMIT 0.0719 ETH @ 2504.64 (GTC) — never filled, **cancelled** at session close
- **Flatten:** SELL MARKET 0.0719 ETH filled @ avg 2502.95 → proceeds 179.96211 USDT
- **Flat state:** confirmed no open orders remain; ~0.000028 ETH dust left (≈$0.07, below minNotional, left as dust)
- **Session P&L:** −0.257 USDT (180.21888 spent vs 179.96211 received), driven by spread/commission since the take-profit never triggered
